sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Alan Turing influenced John McCarthy in 1950. John McCarthy founded AI Laboratory in 1956. The Dartmouth Conference occurred in 1956.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: The Apollo program was developed by NASA. Apollo 11 occurred in 1969 and Neil Armstrong influenced public interest in space exploration.

sections.heading: Development
sections.content: ARPANET preceded the modern Internet in 1969. Tim Berners Lee founded the World Wide Web project in 1989 and influenced software standards.
